title: Celeste secretly cheats to help you win
description: Celeste is hard, yet it is full of hidden forgiveness. Here are the tricks that make its controls feel fair.

scenes.say: Celeste is brutally hard, yet it feels fair. That's because the game quietly bends the rules in your favour.

right.label: Forgiving
items: Jump just after leaving a ledge

scenes.say: You can jump a moment after running off a ledge, and wall jump from two pixels away.

lines: Jump just after leaving a ledge
Press jump early and it still counts
Clip a corner and you get nudged past
Gravity halves at the top of a jump
scenes.say: Press jump slightly early, and it still counts. Clip a corner, and the game nudges you past it. Gravity is halved at the top of a held jump.
Dashing into a ledge corner can pop you on top, too. None of this is shown on screen. You just feel like a better player than you are.
Two pixels is a quarter of a tile. Tiny forgiveness, huge feel. Follow for more game feel secrets.
